heroTitle: Turn Scanned PDFs into Editable Text
heroDescription: Use advanced browser-based OCR to extract text from scanned images and unsearchable PDFs. 100% free and private.

sections.subTitle: WebAssembly OCR
sections.subContent: Tesseract OCR runs right in your browser. No cloud APIs involved.

sections.subTitle: Confidential Extraction
sections.subContent: Extract text from sensitive ID cards or medical records safely.

sections.subTitle: High Accuracy
sections.subContent: Support for multiple languages and skewed scans.

faqs.q: Does this OCR support multiple languages?
faqs.a: Yes, our Tesseract-based WebAssembly engine supports over 100 languages. Just ensure the scan is clear.

faqs.q: Is it safe to extract text from my passport or ID?
faqs.a: Absolutely. We do not upload your documents to our servers. The entire OCR process happens within your own browser.

faqs.q: Why is the text sometimes inaccurate?
faqs.a: OCR accuracy depends heavily on the image quality. For best results, ensure your scans have high contrast and are not blurry.
